paragraphs.text: Search the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness
# dshbase-catalog
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install comm
ands for 1,100+ community plugins without leaving your session.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2, including Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`. Framework packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh
`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`) are `peerDependencies` resolved from the host in
stall, and every tool `parameters` block is a JSON Schema object root.
## Tools
| Tool | Description |

| `search_dsh_plugins` | Full-text search across plugin name + description |
| `get_dsh_plugin` | Lo

ok up one plugin: install command, verification status, stats |
| `list_dsh_plugins` | List plugins

by category |
| `get_dsh_stats` | Catalog totals (plugins, npm vs git, verification) |
| `get_dsh_ca
tegories` | All categories with counts |
## Data
The catalog snapshot is regenerated daily from the live dshbase directory (see `scripts/sync-catalog
.py`), so the built-in index stays current.
